reviews.title: Super Glitchy
reviews.text: I can’t count how many times I’ve saved my fast at night and woken up in the morning to end it, and somehow it wasn’t saved. Same thing happens when I try to start my next fast. Even though I get the fast saved confetti, somehow it thinks I’m still fasting. I wonder if the saving issue is a perpetual problem with having to edit the time, because it didn’t get save right the first time? Looking for a new app. The charts are also not that helpful. Gave it an extra star for pleasant appearance and attractive color scheme.

reviews.title: Subscription Based
reviews.text: You get access to some things on the free app but requiring a subscription to unlock all the features is asinine. Especially for $10 a month. It’s essentially a glorified timer.

reviews.title: So-so
reviews.text: I was liking it but…I guess I had an earlier version downloaded and I accidentally updated the app and now it wants me to pay for features that I was already using before the update.  Not cool.

reviews.title: Just Log Your Own Fasts
reviews.text: Gave two stars as at least you can do a simple fast -for now- but this app has completely nose-dived since its inception with the aggressively overpriced and MONTHLY subscription. This doesn't work after you initially gave full access to the app's features. Not to mention this app is obviously collecting your fasting data, and seeing how profit-driven they are, it might be best to just use your notepad or physical journal to track your fasts...
